slides.say: Some array methods change the array in place. In React state, you avoid those.
Avoid push, unshift, pop, shift, splice, sort and reverse. Prefer concat, spread, filter, slice and map.

slides.text: slice copies. splice (with a p!) mutates.
slides.say: Watch the names. Slice copies an array. Splice, with a p, mutates it.
Need to sort or reverse? Copy the array first, then call the mutating method on your copy.
